'''Magical Pokémon Journey: Pokémon Holiday''' is the third monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]]. It contains the fifth and sixth chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of {{Vol|Magical Pokémon Journey|1}}. As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
==Blurb==
'''''JIGGLYPUFF ROASTING ON AN OPEN FIRE'''''

''It's a Pokémon Christmas! Pikachu agrees to deliver a mirror as a present to Hazel from Hazel's granddad, but accidentally breaks it! Quick, are there any Pokémon with reflective surfaces?'' 

''Then, Hazel and all her friends are invited to a castle...but who or what is the lord of the manor?''
